headline: Dinars to Dollars - Tabaqchali Explains Market Gap | Iraq Business News
summary: The growing gap between Iraq's official dinar exchange rate and its informal market value has been reported. Ahmed Tabaqchali attributes the dinar's fall to the behaviour of certain importers.
why: The Iraqi dinar's official rate versus its parallel market rate affects import costs and inflation in an economy heavily reliant on oil revenues. Currency gaps signal stress in FX access.
